doc.brief: The QLineEdit widget is a one-line text editor.

QAction * addAction(const QIcon &icon, Q.brief: Creates a new action with the given *icon* at the *position*.

QCompleter * completer() const.brief: Returns the current [QCompleter](xref:qt:QCompleter) that provides completions.

QLineEdit(QWidget *parent).brief: Constructs a line edit with no text.

QLineEdit(const QString &contents, QWidg.brief: Constructs a line edit containing the text *contents* as a child of *parent*.

QLineEdit::EchoMode echoMode() const.brief: This property holds the line edit's echo mode.

QMenu * createStandardContextMenu().brief: Creates the standard context menu, which is shown when the user clicks on the line edit with the right mouse button.

QRect cursorRect() const.brief: Returns a rectangle that includes the line edit cursor.

QSize minimumSizeHint() const override.brief: Reimplements an access function for property: [QWidget::minimumSizeHint](xref:qt:QWidget).

QSize sizeHint() const override.brief: Reimplements an access function for property: [QWidget::sizeHint](xref:qt:QWidget).

QString displayText() const.brief: This property holds the displayed text.

QString inputMask() const.brief: This property holds the validation input mask.

QString placeholderText() const.brief: This property holds the line edit's placeholder text.

QString selectedText() const.brief: This property holds the selected text.

QString text() const.brief: This property holds the line edit's text.

Qt::Alignment alignment() const.brief: This property holds the alignment of the line edit.

Qt::CursorMoveStyle cursorMoveStyle() co.brief: This property holds the movement style of the cursor in this line edit.

bool dragEnabled() const.brief: This property holds whether the line edit starts a drag if the user presses and moves the mouse on some selected text.

bool hasAcceptableInput() const.brief: This property holds whether the input satisfies the [inputMask](xref:qt:QLineEdit) and the validator.

bool hasFrame() const.brief: This property holds whether the line edit draws itself with a frame.

bool hasSelectedText() const.brief: This property holds whether there is any text selected.

bool isClearButtonEnabled() const.brief: This property holds whether the line edit displays a clear button when it is not empty.

bool isModified() const.brief: This property holds whether the line edit's contents has been modified by the user.

bool isReadOnly() const.brief: This property holds whether the line edit is read-only.

bool isRedoAvailable() const.brief: This property holds whether redo is available.

bool isUndoAvailable() const.brief: This property holds whether undo is available.

const QValidator * validator() const.brief: Returns a pointer to the current input validator, or `nullptr` if no validator has been set.

int cursorPosition() const.brief: This property holds the current cursor position for this line edit.

int cursorPositionAt(const QPoint &pos).brief: Returns the cursor position under the point *pos*.

int maxLength() const.brief: This property holds the maximum permitted length of the text.

int selectionEnd() const.brief: Returns the index of the character directly after the selection in the line edit (or -1 if no text is selected).

int selectionLength() const.brief: Returns the length of the selection.

int selectionStart() const.brief: Returns the index of the first selected character in the line edit (or -1 if no text is selected).

void addAction(QAction *action, QLineEdi.brief: Adds the *action* to the list of actions at the *position*.

void backspace().brief: If no text is selected, deletes the character to the left of the text cursor, and moves the cursor one position to the left.

void clear().brief: Clears the contents of the line edit.

void copy() const.brief: Copies the selected text to the clipboard, if there is any, and if [echoMode](xref:qt:QLineEdit)() is [Normal](xref:qt:QLineEdit).

void cursorPositionChanged(int oldPos, i.brief: This signal is emitted whenever the cursor moves.

void cursorWordBackward(bool mark).brief: Moves the cursor one word backward.

void cursorWordForward(bool mark).brief: Moves the cursor one word forward.

void cut().brief: Copies the selected text to the clipboard and deletes it, if there is any, and if [echoMode](xref:qt:QLineEdit)() is [Normal](xref:qt:QLineEdit).

void del().brief: If no text is selected, deletes the character to the right of the text cursor.

void editingFinished().brief: This signal is emitted when the Return or Enter key is used, or if the line edit loses focus and its contents have changed since the last time this signal was emitted.

void end(bool mark).brief: Moves the text cursor to the end of the line unless it is already there.

void home(bool mark).brief: Moves the text cursor to the beginning of the line unless it is already there.

void initStyleOption(QStyleOptionFrame *.brief: Initialize *option* with the values from this [QLineEdit](xref:qt:QLineEdit).

void inputRejected().brief: This signal is emitted when the user uses a key that is not considered to be valid input.

void insert(const QString &newText).brief: Deletes any selected text, inserts *newText*, and validates the result.

void paste().brief: Inserts the clipboard's text at the cursor position, deleting any selected text, providing the line edit is not [read-only](xref:qt:QLineEdit).

void redo().brief: Redoes the last operation if redo is [available](xref:qt:QLineEdit).

void returnPressed().brief: This signal is emitted when the Return or Enter key is used.

void selectAll().brief: Selects all the text (highlights it) and moves the cursor to the end.

void selectionChanged().brief: This signal is emitted whenever the selection changes.

void setAlignment(Qt::Alignment flag).brief: This property holds the alignment of the line edit.

void setClearButtonEnabled(bool enable).brief: This property holds whether the line edit displays a clear button when it is not empty.

void setCompleter(QCompleter *c).brief: Sets this line edit to provide auto completions from the completer, *c*.

void setCursorMoveStyle(Qt::CursorMoveSt.brief: This property holds the movement style of the cursor in this line edit.

void setCursorPosition(int).brief: This property holds the current cursor position for this line edit.

void setDragEnabled(bool b).brief: This property holds whether the line edit starts a drag if the user presses and moves the mouse on some selected text.

void setEchoMode(QLineEdit::EchoMode).brief: This property holds the line edit's echo mode.

void setFrame(bool).brief: This property holds whether the line edit draws itself with a frame.

void setInputMask(const QString &inputMa.brief: This property holds the validation input mask.

void setMaxLength(int).brief: This property holds the maximum permitted length of the text.

void setModified(bool).brief: This property holds whether the line edit's contents has been modified by the user.

void setPlaceholderText(const QString &).brief: This property holds the line edit's placeholder text.

void setReadOnly(bool).brief: This property holds whether the line edit is read-only.

void setSelection(int start, int length).brief: Selects text from position *start* and for *length* characters.

void setText(const QString &).brief: This property holds the line edit's text.

void setTextMargins(const QMargins &marg.brief: Sets the *margins* around the text inside the frame.

void setTextMargins(int left, int top, i.brief: Sets the margins around the text inside the frame to have the sizes *left*, *top*, *right*, and *bottom*.

void setValidator(const QValidator *v).brief: Sets the validator for values of line edit to *v*.

void textChanged(const QString &text).brief: This signal is emitted whenever the text changes.

void textEdited(const QString &text).brief: This signal is emitted whenever the text is edited.

void undo().brief: Undoes the last operation if undo is [available](xref:qt:QLineEdit).
